input.description: the first matrix to be matrix multiplied

mat2.description: the second matrix to be matrix multiplied

out_dtype.description: the dtype of the output tensor, Supported only on CUDA and for torch.float32 given torch.float16/torch.bfloat16 input dtypes
constraints: Supported only on CUDA and for torch.float32 given torch.float16/torch.bfloat16 input dtypes

output.description: If input is a (n × m) tensor, mat2 is a (m × p) tensor, out will be a (n × p) tensor.

constraints: mat1 shape must match input's shape if provided
